speaker: Doctor

The urinalysis shows leukocyturia and eosinophilic crystals, which are highly suggestive of an allergic interstitial nephritis; do you have a history of allergies or a rash associated with the antibiotics you took? Also, has your urine appeared cloudy or foul-smelling?

REQUEST TEST: Serum Creatinine

speaker: Doctor
text:
The serum creatinine results show elevated levels, confirming kidney injury. Given the history of recent antibiotic use and the presence of eosinophilic crystals, does the rash or other allergic symptoms persist? Are you experiencing nausea or vomiting alongside the flank pain?

REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests

speaker: Doctor
text:
The latest results indicate normal liver function, but we previously saw elevated creatinine; can you tell me the specific antibiotic you took for your sinusitis and if you developed a rash while on it? I also need to know if your flank pain has shifted or if you are experiencing any abdominal discomfort.

REQUEST TEST: Serum Creatinine (Repeat)
REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity.

The combination of fever, flank pain, fatigue, recent antibiotic use, eosinophilic crystals, and elevated creatinine confirms kidney injury from an allergic reaction. The normal liver function helps rule out hepatorenal syndrome or other systemic drug toxicities. I will now request images of the kidney ultrasound to assess for any structural changes or obstruction.
